This page shares resources I've found excellent for academic beginners.

# Books

### Finance

- [The Economist's Craft](https://press.princeton.edu/books/hardcover/9780691216492/the-economists-craft): An Introduction to Research, Publishing, and Professional Development, Michael S. Weisbach, 2021, Princeton University Press.
- [Tidy Finance](https://www.tidy-finance.org/)
- Cochrane, J. H. (2005). [*Asset Pricing*](https://www.johnhcochrane.com/asset-pricing). Princeton University Press.

### Data Science

- [Data Science Live Book](https://livebook.datascienceheroes.com/), Pablo Casas, 2019.
- [Cookbook for R](http://www.cookbook-r.com/), Winston Chang, 2013.

# Websites

- [Prof. Robert Faff's Pitching Research Template](https://pitchingresearch.com/)

- [Finance Conference Calendar](https://afajof.org/conference-calendar/) via [AFA](https://afajof.org/)

- [Manning Publications](https://www.manning.com/) for technical books.
